messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Pager triggered — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/complete (hosted API). Pager: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345. Root ts: 1812345678. Symptoms: 5xx rate ~3.8% over last 2m, p95 latency up. Paging on-call: @josephine. Please ACK.

josephine: Acked. I'm on-call and joining the war room. War room: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij. Taking incident commander. @ben s can you stand by for runtime config rollback? I'll start a quick triage: tailing logs and checking recent deploys.

ben s: I'm here. Initial glance: saw increased mem pressure on pool-gamma GPUs, KV-cache evictions spike. I'm going to revert model variant routing for hosted-api to stable-v2 and disable continuous batching on pool-gamma. Running commands now:

```
# revert routing
redwoodctl routing set /v1/complete --model stable-v2 --env prod

# disable continuous batching
redwoodctl pool update pool-gamma --continuous-batching=false
```

I'll report back when done.

maria_g: Observability: linking dashboard + customer impact -- https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/hosted-api-overview. Graphs show 5xx spike starting at 1812345400. Affected region: us-west primarily. Estimated affected request volume ~3-4% of total traffic, majority are short completions. No dedicated customers flagged yet.

sam_k: I'm owner for status page. Draft status update below — please review/edit then I'll publish.

```
Status: Investigating
Components: Hosted API (/v1/complete)
Impact: Elevated 5xx errors for a subset of requests in us-west; intermittent failures for some customers.
Next update: 30 minutes or sooner
Notes: Our engineers are actively mitigating; no data loss suspected.
```

If that looks good I'll push to status.redwood.com.

sre-lead: Assign external comms to me. I'll coordinate customer outreach if we confirm broader impact. @josephine please ping me when you have rollback confirmation.

josephine: Ben confirmed rollback started. Ben — update on timing?

ben s: Rollback completed at 1812346000. 5xx rate dropped to baseline within ~60s of rollback. Monitoring shows improvement, p95 latency trending down. Leaving continuous batching disabled for now. Will prepare a postmortem action item for KV cache tuning.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: No recent deploys to hosted-api in the last 30m.

incident-bot: NOTE: Oncall handoff scheduled at 1812347400. Current owner josephine -> handoff to ben s if incident remains open. Remember to document timeline in the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.infra/incidents/P12345.

josephine: Thanks team. Taking next steps:
- sam_k please publish the status page update (above)
- sre-lead draft customer notification only if we see sustained errors or if enterprise customers ping support
- ben and I will keep monitoring for 30m, then move to containment -> mitigation -> RCA.
If anyone sees regressions, post here and escalate. :thumbsup:
